title: Eric Bard replicates the anomalies with a neodymium magnet
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Eric Bard replicates the anomalies with a neodymium magnet, about c. 2020 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he was able to later replicate those anomalies by focusing intense electromagnetic force

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, tells of something from around 2020 that was shown in the first season of the TV series The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch. He says a team member named Eric Bard was later able to recreate the odd readings seen on the ranch by focusing intense electromagnetic force with a very strong magnet. If true, it would suggest powerful electromagnetic fields are behind what happens there.
